rule: Historical New Game starting snapshots only. A save that starts in 1980 never loads the 1981 historical snapshot.
Current year Y uses evidence/results through Y-1 only. Same-year results may be post-hoc QA only.
Annual team assignment is season-history QA only, not a guaranteed Jan-1 contract assignment.
Current Ability is weighted composite of 16 current attributes, capped at Peak Ability.
Peak uses full-career hindsight. R2 enforces Peak Ability >= weighted Peak Attribute composite and adds conservative career/junior/truncated-career floors when supported.
Availability is categorical and separate from ability. Gap/retirement/death does not silently rewrite skill ratings.
Peak floor = max(existing Peak, weighted Peak Attribute composite, conservative full-career floor, high-confidence junior floor, truncated-career floor where applicable).
60 + min(15, 0.10 × career starts) + 1.5 × sqrt(podiums) + 1.2 × wins + 0.5 × poles; capped at 90.
When researched readiness >= 0.90: 62 + 14 × readiness. This is a moderate potential floor, not a Current Rating boost.
For a fatal career truncation before age 30, <=30 F1 starts and readiness >=0.90: min(91, 78 + 12 × readiness).
If a Peak floor rises, all Peak Attributes shift by the amount needed for their weighted composite to meet the new ceiling, preserving relative profile shape and clamping at 99.
